summary: thiscall teardown. Runs two cleanup passes on the object: ConditionalDualCleanup on a sub-object at this+224, then sub_485EB0 on the object itself. When the low bit of flag a2 is set, the object is freed through FreeWrapper_7bcf. Returns this.

operations.description: Call ConditionalDualCleanup((_DWORD *)(this + 224)) to clean a sub-object located at offset 224 of this.
Call sub_485EB0((LPVOID *)this) as the second cleanup pass on the object itself.
Guard on (a2 & 1) != 0; the object is freed only when the low bit of a2 is set.
Call FreeWrapper_7bcf((LPVOID)this) to release the object memory.
